nodes.label: Find Paddle layout regions without depending on one response version.
nodes.norm_label: find paddle layout regions without depending on one response version.

nodes.label: Grounded Document Parser
nodes.rationale: Produces grounded, layout-aware Markdown and hierarchical JSON while rejecting unsupported text.

nodes.label: Luna Candidate Verification
nodes.rationale: Cloud verification is bounded to candidate IDs; novel corrections remain provisional until an independent wider 2x GLM retry agrees.

nodes.label: Terra Cross-Page Reasoning
nodes.rationale: May resolve roles and relationships across pages but cannot rewrite source text.

nodes.label: Deterministic Grounding Gate
nodes.rationale: Numeric disagreements are always conflicts and unsupported text is rejected to reduce hallucination.

nodes.label: Secure Offline Container Runtime
nodes.rationale: Parsing uses a digest-pinned image with networking disabled, read-only storage, isolated mounts, dropped capabilities, and resource limits.

nodes.label: Bounded Agentic Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Specialized models may classify and relate regions, but deterministic validation constrains them and they cannot freely rewrite source content.

nodes.label: Physical and Semantic Dual-Index Hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Pages preserve physical references while Sections provide semantic navigation.

nodes.label: LandingAI 99.16% DocVQA Claim
nodes.rationale: The result used Markdown plus spatial JSON and guided prompting on a specific proprietary-parser benchmark; it does not transfer automatically to other corpora.

nodes.label: Accuracy Evidence Gap
nodes.rationale: The project has no comparable benchmark, so a 99% or extremely-high-accuracy claim is unsupported.

nodes.label: Two Independent Local OCR Paths
nodes.rationale: Independent local evidence supports disagreement detection and rejection of unsupported model text.

nodes.label: OpenAI Structured Outputs
nodes.rationale: Schema conformance does not establish factual correctness; evidence validation remains necessary.

nodes.label: Explicit Per-Run Cloud Consent
nodes.rationale: OpenAI must never receive document content unless the user explicitly opts in for that run.

nodes.label: Untrusted Boundary Validation
nodes.rationale: Uploads, model outputs, provider errors, links, Markdown, and container images are all treated as untrusted.
